resources.string: Aegis needs this to see which app is in the foreground, so it can enforce the app blocks and time budgets you set; and to read the address and page text in other browsers, so it can block explicit content there the way it does in its own browser. Page text is classified on this device, held only in memory, and never stored or uploaded. Only the hostname and the reason for a block are kept.
Shows while the on-device filter is running.
Blocking requests locally. Nothing leaves the device.
